chunks: Ali, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah عليه السلام:
That the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbade that al-hanut be placed upon the bier.

key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ عَلَيْهِ السَّلَامُ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Sadiq عليه السلام, the Imam transmitting the report
key_terms.النَّبِيَّ: the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم, the source of the ruling being transmitted
key_terms.النَّعْشِ: the bier or funeral stretcher upon which the deceased is carried
key_terms.الْحَنُوطُ: the perfuming substance used for the deceased in funerary rites
key_terms.نَهَى: forbade; indicates a prohibition in the report

ai.seo_question: What did the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم forbid regarding placing al-hanut on the bier?
ai.summary: This hadith reports a prohibition from the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم regarding placing al-hanut upon the bier. It relates to funerary jurisprudence and indicates a prescribed limit for how perfuming substances are to be used in the rites of the deceased.
